oe_v45_act_silver_manila_galleon = {
	icon = create_trade
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
			NOT = { country_type = pop }
			NOT = { country_type = building }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 120
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_manila_galleon_charter }
		}
	}
	cooldown = {
		type = oe_v45_act_silver_manila_galleon_cd
		years = 6
	}
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = {
			situation:oe_sit_v45_global_silver_flow = {
				add_to_list = source
			}
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:oe_sit_v45_global_silver_flow = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -120
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_manila_galleon_charter years = 12 mode = replace }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_participant value = 1 }
			add_navy_tradition = 5
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_ws_5_seen } } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_5_seen value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v45_ws.5 }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_silver_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_index value = 35 } }
			change_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_index add = 8 }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_silver_index > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_index value = 100 } }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_silver_index < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_index value = 0 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_v45_act_silver_manila_galleon_tt
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 280 } } add = 14 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 165 } } add = -12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { at_war = no } } add = 6 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { num_of_ports >= 3 } } add = 12 }
	}
}

		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 150
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_steam_pump_engineering }
		}
	}
	cooldown = {
		type = oe_v45_act_ind_steam_pumps_cd
		years = 7
	}
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = {
			situation:oe_sit_v45_proto_industrialization = {
				add_to_list = source
			}
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:oe_sit_v45_proto_industrialization = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -150
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_steam_pump_engineering years = 14 mode = replace }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_pioneer value = 1 }
			add_research_progress = 10
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_ws_21_seen } } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_21_seen value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v45_ws.21 }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_ind_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_index value = 20 } }
			change_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_index add = 11 }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_ind_index > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_index value = 100 } }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_ind_index < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_index value = 0 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_v45_act_ind_steam_pumps_tt
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 310 } } add = 14 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 195 } } add = -12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { at_war = no } } add = 6 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { any_owned_location = { raw_material ?= goods:coal } } } add = 18 }
	}
}
